sensors.name: left light sensor LLIGHT (bright or dim)

control_flow: followInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 70 (dark) then if the line tracker is under 90 curve left (10/30), else if over 90 curve right (30/10), else call avoidWalls; else (bright) call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if LLIGHT < 70 (dark) then if LEFT obstacle turn right 20°, else if RIGHT obstacle turn left 20°, else call driveInTheDark; else (bright) call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 70 (dark) drive forward 30 %; else (bright) call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if FRONT obstacle stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black curve left (10/40); else curve right (40/10).
